title: rosa canina var. frondosa
intro: Rosa canina var. frondosa, commonly known as Dwarf Dog Rose or Wild Rose, is a shrub-like perennial plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. frondosa include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's ability to modulate hormonal imbalances, soothe digestive issues, and protect against oxidative stress.
